verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence documents a CLI, Skills, Ledger and local read-only views, but nothing describes an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The Ledger's 'bounded local views' is an adjacent feature and is not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
